<CLT=cltMIND>I tried so hard, Kaede...
I tried...to protect them...

<CLT=cltMIND>Just seven of us left.
Less than half...

<CLT=cltMIND>You always tried to help us
in your own, strange way.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>
you discovered...

<CLT=cltMIND>A horrible truth.
To save us from that, you were willing to kill...
